newsitem.title: USA: Redhook sees Q3 EPS between $0.10 and $0.11.
newsitem.headline: Redhook sees Q3 EPS between $0.10 and $0.11.

text.p: Redhook Ale Brewery Inc said on Thursday that its 1996 third quarter earnings will be $0.10 to $0.11 a share compared with $0.12 a share a year ago.

That estimate includes the effect of a 21 percent increase in average common equivalent shares outstanding, the company said in a statement. Redhook also said its sales volume for the quarter totaled 57,600 barrels, up 43 percent from the year-ago period. Shipments in August and to a lesser extent September, were below the company's expectations and negatively impacted the earnings.

The shortfall from expected sales volumes was most significant in Northern California, during August and to a lesser extent September. Redhook said that in recent months it made a transition of distributors in the San Francisco Bay Area to Anheuser-Busch affiliated distributors, which is hoped will provide an opportunity to expand in that region.
The company said it also had shortfalls in other markets, including Washington state. Redhook is an independent brewer of craft beers in the United States.
